adoration.text: Adoration Room open 6.00am to 10.15pm daily; closed every Wednesday 10.00am–12 noon for cleaning.

confession.text: 30 minutes before every weekend Mass, in the Main Church.

devotions.text: Divine Mercy Devotion: Tuesdays 6.45pm in the Main Church
Rosary Prayers: Mondays to Fridays 5.15pm in the Main Church
Christian Meditation: Wednesdays 8pm in St John/St Luke room

office_hours.text: Parish Office: Mon & Sat 9am–6pm, Tue–Fri 9am–8pm, Sun 9am–1pm; closed on public holidays.

good_to_know.text: OLPS Church carpark is open 5.30am–10.30pm daily.
Overflow parking at St Stephen's School: Saturdays 3pm–7pm, Sundays 8am–2pm; no overnight parking.
Standing along the aisles during Mass and services is not permitted; please keep walkways and exits clear.

events.title: OYP Outreach for Secondary 4 & 5 Students
events.text: At Catholic Centre #08-01, 55 Waterloo St, 10am–1pm with registration from 9.45am. Free; register at tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov.
